versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ πέντε ἡμέρας κατέβη ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς Ἀνανίας μετὰ πρεσβυτέρων τινῶν καὶ ῥήτορος Τερτύλλου τινός, οἵτινες ἐνεφάνισαν τῷ ἡγεμόνι κατὰ τοῦ Παύλου.

controles.web: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.
controles.kjv: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.
controles.livre: E cinco dias depois, desceu o sumo sacerdote Ananias, com os anciãos e um certo orador Tértulo; os quais compareceram diante do governador contra Paulo.

versos.grego: κληθέντος δὲ αὐτοῦ ἤρξατο κατηγορεῖν ὁ Τέρτυλλος λέγων Πολλῆς εἰρήνης τυγχάνοντες διὰ σοῦ καὶ διορθωμάτων γινομένων τῷ ἔθνει τούτῳ διὰ τῆς σῆς προνοίας,

controles.web: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that excellent measures are coming to this nation,
controles.kjv: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,
controles.livre: E sendo chamado, Tértulo começou a acusá -lo ,dizendo:

versos.grego: πάντῃ τε καὶ πανταχοῦ ἀποδεχόμεθα, κράτιστε Φῆλιξ, μετὰ πάσης εὐχαριστίας.

controles.web: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
controles.kjv: We accept it always, and in all places, most noble Felix, with all thankfulness.
controles.livre: Visto que há muita paz por causa de ti, e que por teu governo muitos bons serviços estão sendo feitos a esta nação, excelentíssimo Félix, totalmente e em todo lugar, com todo agradecimento o reconhecemos.

versos.grego: ἵνα δὲ μὴ ἐπὶ πλεῖόν σε ἐνκόπτω, παρακαλῶ ἀκοῦσαί σε ἡμῶν συντόμως τῇ σῇ ἐπιεικείᾳ.

controles.web: But, that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.
controles.livre: Mas para que eu não gaste muito o teu tempo, rogo -te que tu nos ouças brevemente, conforme a tua clemência.

versos.grego: εὑρόντες γὰρ τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦτον λοιμὸν καὶ κινοῦντα στάσεις πᾶσιν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις τοῖς κατὰ τὴν οἰκουμένην πρωτοστάτην τε τῆς τῶν Ναζωραίων αἱρέσεως,

controles.web: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
controles.kjv: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:
controles.livre: Porque nós temos achado que este homem é uma peste, e levantador de rebeliões entre todos os judeus pelo mundo, e o principal defensor da seita dos nazarenos.

versos.grego: ὃς καὶ τὸ ἱερὸν ἐπείρασεν βεβηλῶσαι, ὃν καὶ ἐκρατήσαμεν,

controles.web: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.
controles.kjv: Who also hath gone about to profane the temple: whom we took, and would have judged according to our law.
controles.livre: O qual também tentou profanar o Templo; ao qual também prendemos;

versos.grego: παρ’ οὗ δυνήσῃ αὐτὸς ἀνακρίνας περὶ πάντων τούτων ἐπιγνῶναι ὧν ἡμεῖς κατηγοροῦμεν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”
controles.kjv: Commanding his accusers to come unto thee: by examining of whom thyself mayest take knowledge of all these things, whereof we accuse him.
controles.livre: Mandando aos acusadores dele que viessem a ti; investigando-o tu mesmo, poderás entender todas estas coisas das quais o acusamos.

versos.grego: συνεπέθεντο δὲ καὶ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι φάσκοντες ταῦτα οὕτως ἔχειν.

controles.web: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.
controles.kjv: And the Jews also assented, saying that these things were so.
controles.livre: E os judeus também concordaram, dizendo serem estas coisas assim.

versos.grego: Ἀπεκρίθη τε ὁ Παῦλος, νεύσαντος αὐτῷ τοῦ ἡγεμόνος λέγειν Ἐκ πολλῶν ἐτῶν ὄντα σε κριτὴν τῷ ἔθνει τούτῳ ἐπιστάμενος εὐθύμως τὰ περὶ ἐμαυτοῦ ἀπολογοῦμαι,

controles.web: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,
controles.kjv: Then Paul, after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak, answered, Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation, I do the more cheerfully answer for myself:
controles.livre: Mas Paulo, fazendo gesto ao governador para que falasse, respondeu: Sabendo eu que por muitos anos tu tens sido juiz desta nação, com maior ânimo eu me defendo.

versos.grego: δυναμένου σου ἐπιγνῶναι ὅτι οὐ πλείους εἰσίν μοι ἡμέραι δώδεκα ἀφ’ ἧς ἀνέβην προσκυνήσων εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ,

controles.web: seeing that you can recognize that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: Because that thou mayest understand, that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship.
controles.livre: Pois tu podes entender que há não mais que doze dias, eu tinha subido a Jerusalém para adorar.

versos.grego: καὶ οὔτε ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ εὗρόν με πρός τινα διαλεγόμενον ἢ ἐπίστασιν ποιοῦντα ὄχλου, οὔτε ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς οὔτε κατὰ τὴν πόλιν,

controles.web: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues, or in the city.
controles.kjv: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
controles.livre: E nem me acharam falando com alguém no Templo, nem incitando ao povo, nem nas sinagogas, nem na cidade.

versos.grego: οὐδὲ παραστῆσαι δύνανταί σοι περὶ ὧν νυνὶ κατηγοροῦσίν μου.

controles.web: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.
controles.kjv: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me.
controles.livre: E nem podem provar as coisas das quais agora estão me acusando.

versos.grego: ὁμολογῶ δὲ τοῦτό σοι, ὅτι κατὰ τὴν Ὁδὸν ἣν λέγουσιν αἵρεσιν οὕτως λατρεύω τῷ πατρῴῳ Θεῷ, πιστεύων πᾶσι τοῖς κατὰ τὸν νόμον καὶ τοῖς ἐν τοῖς προφήταις γεγραμμένοις,

controles.web: But this I confess to you, that after the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;
controles.kjv: But this I confess unto thee, that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets:
controles.livre: Mas isto eu te confesso, que conforme o Caminho que eles chamam de seita, assim eu sirvo ao Deus dos meus pais, crendo em tudo que está escrito na Lei e nos profetas;

versos.grego: ἐλπίδα ἔχων εἰς τὸν Θεόν, ἣν καὶ αὐτοὶ οὗτοι προσδέχονται, ἀνάστασιν μέλλειν ἔσεσθαι δικαίων τε καὶ ἀδίκων.

controles.web: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
controles.kjv: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
controles.livre: Tendo esperança em Deus, ao qual estes mesmos também esperam, que vai haver ressurreição dos mortos, tanto dos justos como dos injustos.

versos.grego: ἐν τούτῳ καὶ αὐτὸς ἀσκῶ ἀπρόσκοπον συνείδησιν ἔχειν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν καὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους διὰ παντός.

controles.web: Herein I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
controles.kjv: And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.
controles.livre: E nisto eu pratico, em que tanto para com Deus como para com os seres humanos eu sempre tenha uma consciência limpa.

versos.grego: δι’ ἐτῶν δὲ πλειόνων ἐλεημοσύνας ποιήσων εἰς τὸ ἔθνος μου παρεγενόμην καὶ προσφοράς,

controles.web: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
controles.kjv: Now after many years I came to bring alms to my nation, and offerings.
controles.livre: E muitos anos depois, vim para fazer doações e ofertas à minha nação.

versos.grego: ἐν αἷς εὗρόν με ἡγνισμένον ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ, οὐ μετὰ ὄχλου οὐδὲ μετὰ θορύβου,

controles.web: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.
controles.kjv: Whereupon certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, neither with multitude, nor with tumult.
controles.livre: N isto ,tendo eu me purificado, nem com multidões, nem com tumulto, alguns judeus da Ásia me acharam,

versos.grego: τινὲς δὲ ἀπὸ τῆς Ἀσίας Ἰουδαῖοι, οὓς ἔδει ἐπὶ σοῦ παρεῖναι καὶ κατηγορεῖν εἴ τι ἔχοιεν πρὸς ἐμέ.

controles.web: They ought to have been here before you, and to make accusation, if they had anything against me.
controles.kjv: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.
controles.livre: Os quais era necessário que estivessem aqui presentes diante de ti, se tivessem alguma coisa contra mim.

versos.grego: ἢ αὐτοὶ οὗτοι εἰπάτωσαν τί εὗρον ἀδίκημα στάντος μου ἐπὶ τοῦ συνεδρίου,

controles.web: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,
controles.kjv: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
controles.livre: Ou digam estes mesmos, se eles acharam alguma má ação em mim quando eu estava perante o Supremo Conselho;

versos.grego: ἢ περὶ μιᾶς ταύτης φωνῆς ἧς ἐκέκραξα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἑστὼς ὅτι Περὶ ἀναστάσεως νεκρῶν ἐγὼ κρίνομαι σήμερον ἐφ’ ὑμῶν.

controles.web: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”
controles.kjv: Except it be for this one voice, that I cried standing among them, Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day.
controles.livre: A não ser somente esta palavra com que, quando eu estava entre eles, clamei, que pela ressurreição dos mortos eu estou sendo julgado hoje por vós.

versos.grego: Ἀνεβάλετο δὲ αὐτοὺς ὁ Φῆλιξ, ἀκριβέστερον εἰδὼς τὰ περὶ τῆς Ὁδοῦ, εἴπας Ὅταν Λυσίας ὁ χιλίαρχος καταβῇ, διαγνώσομαι τὰ καθ’ ὑμᾶς·

controles.web: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”
controles.kjv: And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way, he deferred them, and said, When Lysias the chief captain shall come down, I will know the uttermost of your matter.
controles.livre: Tendo ouvido estas coisas, Félix, que sabia mais detalhadamente sobre o Caminho, adiou-lhes, dizendo: Quando o comandante Lísias descer, eu procurarei saber melhor de vossos assuntos.

versos.grego: διαταξάμενος τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ τηρεῖσθαι αὐτὸν ἔχειν τε ἄνεσιν καὶ μηδένα κωλύειν τῶν ἰδίων αὐτοῦ ὑπηρετεῖν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody, and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.
controles.kjv: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
controles.livre: E ele mandou ao centurião que guardassem a Paulo, e estivesse com alguma liberdade, e impedir a ninguém dos seus amigos lhe prestasse serviço, ou vir até ele.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ ἡμέρας τινὰς παραγενόμενος ὁ Φῆλιξ σὺν Δρουσίλλῃ τῇ ἰδίᾳ γυναικὶ οὔσῃ Ἰουδαίᾳ μετεπέμψατο τὸν Παῦλον, καὶ ἤκουσεν αὐτοῦ περὶ τῆς εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν πίστεως.

controles.web: But after some days, Felix came with Drusilla, his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
controles.livre: E alguns dias depois, tendo vindo Félix com a mulher dele Drusila, que era judia, mandou chamar a Paulo, e o ouviu sobre a fé em Cristo.

versos.grego: διαλεγομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐγκρατείας καὶ τοῦ κρίματος τοῦ μέλλοντος ἔμφοβος γενόμενος ὁ Φῆλιξ ἀπεκρίθη Τὸ νῦν ἔχον πορεύου, καιρὸν δὲ μεταλαβὼν μετακαλέσομαί σε·

controles.web: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”
controles.kjv: And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled, and answered, Go thy way for this time; when I have a convenient season, I will call for thee.
controles.livre: E ele, tendo discursado sobre a justiça, o domínio próprio, e o julgamento que está por vir, Félix temeu, e respondeu: Por agora vai; e tendo outra oportunidade, eu te chamarei.

versos.grego: ἅμα καὶ ἐλπίζων ὅτι χρήματα δοθήσεται αὐτῷ ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου· διὸ καὶ πυκνότερον αὐτὸν μεταπεμπόμενος ὡμίλει αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often, and talked with him.
controles.kjv: He hoped also that money should have been given him of Paul, that he might loose him: wherefore he sent for him the oftener, and communed with him.
controles.livre: Ele também esperava que lhe fosse dado algum dinheiro por Paulo, para que o soltasse; por isso ele também muitas vezes o mandava chamar, e conversava com ele.

versos.grego: Διετίας δὲ πληρωθείσης ἔλαβεν διάδοχον ὁ Φῆλιξ Πόρκιον Φῆστον· θέλων τε χάριτα καταθέσθαι τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὁ Φῆλιξ κατέλιπε τὸν Παῦλον δεδεμένον.

controles.web: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.
controles.kjv: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix’ room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
controles.livre: Mas tendo completado dois anos, Félix teve por sucessor a Pórcio Festo. E Félix, querendo agradar dos judeus, deixou Paulo preso.
